nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Per-client settings. smsMode: mock or twilio. Slack and mock URLs are set here too. allowTestClock is for tests only: leave it false.

nodes.name: Write Alert Log Line
nodes.notes: Last line of defence: a log line is written first, so an alert exists even if Slack is down.

parameters.content:
## 3. Error alert
Set as the "error workflow" of workflows 1 and 2. Any failure becomes a Slack alert plus a log line, both with the execution id, so nothing fails silently.
